name: Lamech
overview: Lamech is a significant biblical figure noted for his role as the father of Jabal, Jubal, and Tubal-Cain, each pioneering important aspects of early human culture such as livestock, music, and metalworking (Genesis 4:20-22). He is also recorded as a descendant of Enoch through Methusael and is distinguished by his polygamous family structure (Genesis 4:18-19). Additionally, another Lamech, son of Methuselah and father of Noah, lived an exceptionally long life of 777 years and stands in the Messianic lineage as an ancestor of Jesus, underscoring his place in God's redemptive plan.
